name: [🔥NEW] Life Sentence
desc:
🤡🚨 WEEK 4 OF PRISONWEEN IS HERE! - NEW CONFETTI BLASTER! NEW BANG REVOLVER! NEW TOY HAMMER! JOIN IN NOW!

Welcome To Life Sentence! Be an inmate and attempt to survive in a prison where every sentence is a "death" sentence. Rub shoulders with up to 35 fellow inmates in a sprawling jail with unique areas, each filled with interactive furniture and props. Maybe if you're smart enough, you might just find a way to escape!

👮 Be a Guard and keep the Prison Secure.
🚨 Be an Inmate and rule the prison against other dangerous inmates.
🔨 Learn and Craft guns and tools to help you survive in prison.

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation 5
📣 Leaving the game in Combat Will cause you to lose respect, private servers do not save stats.

[CONTROLS]
Drop Item [F/DPad Left]
Stomp [E/DPad Down]
Carry [G/DPad Up]
Reload [R/Button X/Button Square]
Run [LeftShift/LeftThumbStick]
Camera Lock [Left Control/Button Y/Button Triangle]
